## The MiamiShirt Standard


Every piece we print carries the rhythm of the city — bold, breathable, and built for the everyday escape. This is what makes a Miami shirt feel like home.
















### Miami-InspiredDesign


From pastel sunsets to art deco geometry, our graphics are pulled straight from the city’s visual DNA. Each print is a wearable postcard.









### Soft EverydayComfort


Pre-washed, ring-spun cotton that feels like a second skin. We obsess over the hand-feel so you forget you’re wearing anything at all.














### CollectibleAttitude


Limited drops and artist collaborations turn every tee into a keeper. Start your collection and wear the story.


























## The Miami Shirt Life


From beach boardwalks to campus casual, every piece captures the vibrant, sun-drenched rhythm of the 305. This is more than a t-shirt — it's a collectible moment in fabric.










Boardwalk Edition

Golden hour strolls define the Miami silhouette.










Campus Casual

Relaxed fits that move from lecture hall to beachside hangout.










Fabric First

Premium cotton that breathes like the ocean breeze.










Color Stories

A palette pulled straight from Miami's sunsets, sea, and skyline.

# Born in the Magic City.Worn Everywhere.



Miami Shirts started with a simple idea: capture the electric energy of our city and turn it into wearable everyday pieces. Every tee we make carries the rhythm of the streets, the warmth of the sun, and the pulse of a culture that never sleeps.



We are more than a t‑shirt store. We are a creative studio, a travel club, and a love letter to the 305. From the pastel glow of South Beach to the bass of Wynwood walls, our collections are designed for those who move with confidence and dress like they already have a reservation.
































## The Miami Shirt Story


More than just a t-shirt. Every design is a postcard from the city we love — a wearable souvenir of sun, style, and street-level energy.










### Inspired by Miami


Born from the rhythm of Ocean Drive and the colors of Calle Ocho. Our shirts capture the city's electric mix — where Caribbean warmth meets cosmopolitan edge. Every print starts with a moment: a sunrise over the bay, the geometry of a lifeguard stand, the faded glamour of a 1950s motel sign. We translate the city's visual language into wearable art that feels both nostalgic and fresh.








### Made for Daily Movement


Miami is lived outdoors — on bikes along the Venetian Causeway, at pickup basketball games in Wynwood, dancing at a waterfront festival. Our shirts are built for that life. Premium ring-spun cotton that breathes in the humidity, cuts that move with you, and inks that hold their vibrancy through salt air and sunshine. We obsess over the details because your everyday should feel exceptional.














### Souvenirs of Place and Mood


A great shirt should feel like a memory you can wear. Each collection is a limited-run love letter to a specific Miami mood — the hazy pink of a summer sunset, the deep green of a hidden tropical garden, the neon buzz of a late-night ventanita. When you wear one, you carry a piece of that feeling with you. It's not just a t-shirt; it's a postcard from paradise, stamped with the 305.
















## What We Stand For


At Miami Shirts, every tee starts with a feeling. We're built on comfort, self-expression, local pride, and the freedom to style your story — from the beach to the boulevard.










### Comfort First


Every shirt is crafted from premium, breathable fabrics that feel like a second skin — because if you're not comfortable, you're not you. We obsess over softness so you can move freely through the Miami heat.









### Bold Self-Expression


Your tee is your canvas. From vibrant graphics to understated statements, our collections are designed to amplify your voice and let you wear your personality on your sleeve — literally.









### Local Pride


Born in the 305, we celebrate the magic of Miami — the sun, the art, the rhythm, and the people. Every design carries a piece of our city's soul, connecting you to the vibrant culture that inspires us daily.









### Versatile Styling


From sunrise coffee runs to sunset rooftop parties, our tees transition effortlessly. Dress them up, keep them casual — our fits are engineered for the full spectrum of Miami living.
















## The Miami Vibe


From the sun-drenched beaches of South Beach to the electric murals of Wynwood, every Miami Shirt captures a piece of the city's soul. Our designs are born from palm-lined streets, ocean breezes, and the endless summer energy that makes this city iconic.

# The Miami Edit


From salt-kissed beach mornings to the electric hum of Calle Ocho, our latest collection captures the rhythm of the city. Every tee tells a story of sun, style, and weekend spontaneity.








Weekend light, Ocean Drive.





Postcard print, fresh cotton.





Wynwood walls, bold graphics.




















## Ways to StyleGraphic Tees


For beach days, classes, and night-out layering—every tee tells a Miami story.





### Beach Front


Throw your favorite oversized graphic over swimwear. Roll the sleeves, knot the hem, and let the ocean breeze do the rest. Finish with slides and a bucket hat.




### Campus Cool


Tuck a vintage-wash tee into relaxed denim or cargos. Layer with an open linen shirt and fresh sneakers for that effortless between-classes look.




### Night Out Layer


Dress up a dark graphic tee with a tailored blazer and slim trousers. Add a chain necklace and leather loafers to shift from sunset drinks to the dance floor.
































## Everyday Miami Comfort


Designed for the heat, styled for the street. Our tees bring breathable ease, effortless pairing, and a postcard-perfect Miami attitude to your daily rotation.












### Breathable Comfort


Crafted from lightweight, airy cotton that keeps you cool through Miami's sunniest days. The relaxed fit moves with you, from South Beach strolls to sunset rooftop hangs.











### Easy Pairing


Every tee is a versatile foundation piece. Dress it up with linen trousers and loafers, or keep it casual with cut-offs and slides — our colors and cuts work with everything in your closet.











### Memorable Miami Design


Our graphics capture the city's soul — Art Deco pastels, tropical botanicals, and vintage postcard charm. Each print tells a story that turns heads and starts conversations wherever you go.

## Frequently Asked Questions


Quick answers about your Miami Shirts order, sizing, and how to reach our team.







### How do I contact customer support?


You can reach our Miami team by email at , by phone at , or through our contact form. We typically respond within 24 hours on business days.






### Are your t-shirts available for pickup in Miami?


Absolutely. We offer local pickup at our Miami storefront. Select "Local Pickup" at checkout and we'll have your order ready within 2 hours during store hours. Visit us at .






### How do I find the right t-shirt size?


We provide a detailed size guide on every product page. Our tees run true to size with a relaxed, tropical fit. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up for that easy Miami breeze feel.






### What is your return and exchange policy?


We want you to love your Miami shirt. Unworn, unwashed items can be returned or exchanged within 30 days of delivery. Exchanges are free; returns have a small restocking fee. Contact us to start the process.






### Do you ship internationally?


Yes, we ship worldwide. International shipping rates are calculated at checkout. Delivery typically takes 7-14 business days depending on your location. All orders are tracked and insured.






### How can I check the status of my order?


Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. You can also check your order status anytime by logging into your account or reaching out to our support team directly.






Still have questions? We're here to help.

# Return Policy


Last Updated: 6/9/2026



At Miami Shirts, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines your rights for returns and refunds.


## 1. Return Window


You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.


- Items must be unused and in original condition

- Items must be in original packaging

- Receipt or proof of purchase required




## 2. Non-Returnable Items


- Perishable goods

- Custom or personalized items

- Digital products and opened software

- Personal hygiene products that have been opened




## 3. Damaged or Defective Items


If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours for a full refund including shipping costs.


## 4. Contact Us



For returns or questions:


Email: [business_email]


Phone: [business_phone]


Address: [business_address]

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/9/2026



Miami Shirts ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Miami Shirts

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 9, 2026



Miami Shirts is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Miami Shirts

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
